payload.prompt:
Independent review of a 4-prong refactor on the L35_P3_obs observation lesson (5/8/26). All changes are uncommitted in git working tree. Run `git diff HEAD` to see the full scope.

Focus your review on these high-risk areas — DO NOT line-by-line audit the 30+ trivial doc/comment edits.

## Prong A — tex/L35_P3_obs_student.tex (student packet)
Hand-edited tex with these intentional changes:
- 'Day 2' -> 'Day 3' on line ~30 (P3 = day 3 of the 3-period cadence)
- New tcolorbox-wrapped objectives header (Math Obj / Language Obj / Essential Understanding) inserted after title block
- 18 write-space doublings (\framedline width increases, extra ruled lines, doubled \vspace)
- 'You-do' block + paired coordinate grid wrapped in samepage to land on same physical page
- Mystery Graph TikZ clipped to y in [-2,2] via \clip + \path[use as bounding box] to crop excessive bottom whitespace
- Audit: no blooket items referenced (none were present)

CHECK: does the rebuilt PDF (tex/L35_P3_obs_student.pdf) actually achieve these — especially same-page You-do+grid landing on page 2, and the Mystery Graph not being too cramped after the crop? Any LaTeX warnings or errors? Does the tcolorbox styling match the L41_P2_student.tex pattern?

## Prong B — tex/L35_P3_obs_teacher.tex (teacher packet)
Pages 3-6 had narrow tables. Fix: switched xltabular X-with-\hsize-multiplier columns to explicit p{} widths summing within textwidth (~5.80in / 6.5in). Doc went 7 -> 6 pages.

CHECK: are the new p{} widths sensible? Any cell still overflowing or any orphan rows after the Launch row consolidation? Look at the rebuilt PDF.

## Prong C — lessons/L35_P3_obs.yaml (NEW file)
Back-extracted metadata yaml matching the L41_P2.yaml schema. Header comment notes it is METADATA only, not a generator input (the tex is hand-canonical).

CHECK: schema parity with L41_P2.yaml. Phase keys, objectives shape, top-level fields. Note: an early version used 'duration_min' but was renamed to 'minutes' to match L41_P2 — confirm this rename is consistent throughout.

## Prong D — Blooket destructive strip
- 48 items removed from questionbank/registry.jsonl (40 with 'blooket' in id, 8 'bridge-day*' tagged 'blooket-pool')
- ~25 supporting files cleaned (pacers, slide builders, tagging docs, qb.py, web/js/dag.js)
- legacy/ moves: import_blooket_csv.py + Blooket_Import_Zeros_of_Polynomials.csv

CHECK: `grep -ric blooket .` should return 0 outside of CLAUDE.md (policy rule), CONTINUATION_PROMPT.md, and legacy/. Run that grep yourself. Also confirm questionbank/registry.jsonl is still well-formed JSONL (each line valid JSON, total line count = pre-strip - 48 = 949).

## Reporting format
For each prong, give a verdict (PASS / NIT / BLOCKER) and at most 3 sentences. End with a global verdict and any cross-prong consistency issues you spot. Keep total report under 600 words.
